_comment: Cloudreach preparation reuses existing crafting, reinforcement, food, recovery and camp-material mechanics. Arrival unlocks these recipes; they add no Meadows requirement. Weather immunity, a dedicated rope bridge kit and camp service upgrades are deferred until supported by a real consumer. Values are tunable.

cloudreach_camp_boards.name: Heartwood Camp Boards
cloudreach_camp_boards.blurb: Cut heartwood into six wood for familiar tents, bedrolls and camp repairs.

cloudreach_camp_cordage.name: Gale Camp Cordage
cloudreach_camp_cordage.blurb: Separate cliff strands into six fiber for tent ties and bedding.

cloudreach_perch_padding.name: Skyplume Camp Padding
cloudreach_perch_padding.blurb: Bind a shed plume into eight fiber for ordinary camp bedding.

cloudreach_axe_bracing.name: Cliffglass Bracing (axe)
cloudreach_axe_bracing.blurb: Brace your existing tool for 35 more maximum durability.

cloudreach_pickaxe_bracing.name: Cliffglass Bracing (pickaxe)
cloudreach_pickaxe_bracing.blurb: Brace your existing tool for 35 more maximum durability.

cloudreach_recovery_tonic.name: Sunleaf Ridge Tonic
cloudreach_recovery_tonic.blurb: Brew the familiar 80 HP Ridge Tonic. Does not revive a fainted creature.

cloudreach_trail_preserve.name: Cloudberry Trail Preserve
cloudreach_trail_preserve.blurb: Prepare a sustaining meal for stamina recovery, or share it with your team.
